text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — our KV telemetry handshake is dropping events on the canary (gcp-us-east, fw-2). Seeing gaps in sequence_ids 1024-1031. Anyone oncall or owning KV telemetry? Is this blocking the canary?
Maria: I noticed a similar spike on the dashboard at 14:12 UTC, looks like the telemetry agent timed out during warmup. Dashboards show missing `kv_header` for those sequences.
Sam: I'm on the handshake path today — pinged. Can you paste a small log snippet?
Alex: ```
2026-03-15T14:12:03.214Z ERROR handshake.go:78 rpc_dead: conn fd=12 seq=1026 peer=10.4.9.7
2026-03-15T14:12:03.215Z WARN  telemetry_agent.go:142 missing KV_HEADER seq=1026
2026-03-15T14:12:03.216Z INFO  prefetch.go:56 prefetch emitted seq=1026 without header
```
Sam: OK that looks like a race where prefetch emits a sequence before the KV agent completes the header handshake. There's a recent ordering tweak in the batching branch that could be related. I'll spin up a local repro.
Jin: Heads-up: PR #6123 changes prefetch ordering to optimize latency; it may allow token emission before handshake completion. If that's the cause we should gate that change.
Lorna: If PR #6123 is implicated, we should pause its canary until a fix is in. That canary is hitting customer-sim tests now.
Sam: Agreed — I'll add a defensive guard to runtime: if !kv.handshakeDone then buffer until header arrives. Quick patch, tests, and revert canary if needed. ETA ~2h.
Alex: Should we also add an assertion to the telemetry smoke test that verifies handshake precedes emission? Maria, can your team add that to the harness?
Maria: Yes, I'll add a smoke test that asserts `handshake_done` metric before first token. Will push after Sam's patch so CI covers it.
Sam: @Dena (infra-bot) can you disable the canary for commit abc123 (PR 6123) while we triage?
Dena (infra-bot): @Sam deploy-bot: Received request to disable canary for commit abc123. Proceeding to disable in gcp-us-east cluster.
deploy-bot: canary disabled for commit abc123 by request of Sam at 2026-03-15T14:20:10Z.
Sam: Thanks — I'll open the PR (runtime guard) and tag @Maria and @Jin for review.
Jin: I'll take a look at how #6123 interacts with prefetch; might be able to make the ordering change safer.
Lorna: Planning note — hold any further canary promotions for the batching branch until we have the guard + tests.
Alex: Owner summary for tracking: owner=Sam (runtime guard), reviewer=Jin, test=Maria, infra=Dena, blocking_canary=true. I'll update the sprint board and add a dependency on PR 6123.
Sam: Will post PR link in this thread when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
